blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Instruction-based image editing has made rapid progress, yet commercial content production demands more than general instruction following and visual quality. Generated images must preserve product identity, render promotional text accurately, and appeal to users. We present KwaiMind, an image editing system that combines broad editing competence with domain-specific capabilities for e-commerce. KwaiMind integrates an agent-based data engine, a staged adaptation pipeline, and a commercial benchmark. The data engine coordinates filtering, targeted generation, hierarchical annotation, and quality auditing to maintain approximately 1.8 million high-quality editing pairs. Using a multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT), we perform continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning on general and e-commerce data, followed by preference optimization and online reinforcement learning. A general-purpose vision-language judge is complemented by specialized rewards for click-through rate (CTR), text rendering, and fine-grained product consistency. We optimize these objectives through specialized policies and consolidate their capabilities into a single editor via on-policy distillation. To assess practical utility, we introduce Ecom-Bench, covering 11 commercial editing tasks with task-specific visual evaluation and CTR-based ranking. KwaiMind achieves the strongest overall scores among the evaluated open-source editors on ImgEdit, GEdit, both language splits of REDEdit, and Ecom-Bench visual quality, while attaining the highest aggregate CTR ranking score among the compared systems. Offline, CTR-guided optimization increases the proportion of generated images whose predicted CTR exceeds that of the original product image from 12.16% to 37.41%. In an online A/B experiment, CTR-based selection of product main images yields an approximately 2.44% relative increase in actual CTR. These results demonstrate the value of combining domain-specific data, reward-driven alignment, and commercially grounded evaluation for practical image editing.
blocks.zh: 基于指令的图像编辑工作取得了迅速进展,然而,商业内容制作需要的不仅仅是一般的教学和视觉质量。 生成的图像必须保持产品身份,准确制作宣传文本,并吸引用户。 我们介绍KwaiMind,这是一个图像编辑系统,将广泛的编辑能力与特定领域电子商务能力结合起来。 KwaiMind集成了一个基于代理的数据引擎,一个分阶段的适应管道,以及一个商业基准. 数据引擎协调过滤,定向生成,分级注释,以及质量审计,以保持约180万对高质量的编辑对. 我们利用多式联运变压器(MMDIT),对一般和电子商务数据进行持续的培训前培训和监督微调,然后进行优惠优化和在线强化学习。 辅助通用视觉语言法官的是对点击率、文本渲染和精细产品一致性的专门奖励。 我们通过专门政策优化这些目标,并通过政策提炼将其能力整合为单一编辑。 为了评估实际效用,我们引入了Ecom-Bench,涵盖11项商业编辑任务,并有针对任务的视觉评价和基于CTR的排名. KwaiMind在ImgEdit,Gedit上获得评价的开源编辑器中实现最强的整体分数,同时在ReDedit和Ecom-Bench的视觉质量上实现语言分数,同时在比较系统中获得最高的总分CTR排名分数. 离线,CTR制导优化将预测的CTR超过原产品图像的生成图像比例从12.16%提高到37.41%. 在一次在线A/B实验中,基于CTR的产品主图像选择产生实际CTR相对增加约2.44%. 这些结果表明,结合特定领域数据、奖励驱动的调整和基于商业的评价对实际图像编辑很有价值。

blocks.en: Instruction-based image editing has advanced rapidly, and modern diffusion editors can now follow open-domain natural-language instructions to add, remove, replace, restyle, and recompose visual content with high fidelity ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Diffusion models also have broad applications in other domains ( Gong et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025b ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , while e-commerce image production offers a particularly valuable application of instruction-driven editing. On a modern e-commerce platform, every product may require many display images: a garment shown on different models and in different poses, a product placed against a variety of scenes, a promotional poster that highlights selling points, or a clean cutout for a catalog. Producing these images by hand is slow and expensive, and the volume grows with the size of the catalog, which makes automated, instruction-driven editing an attractive and valuable tool for merchants ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于指令的图像编辑工作迅速推进,现代传播编辑人员现在可以遵循开放域的自然语言指令,添加、删除、替换、重塑和重新编译高度忠诚的视觉内容(Brooks等人,2023年;Labs等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年a; Wei等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年). 传播模型在其他领域也有广泛的应用(龚等人,2026年;李等人,2025年;夏等人,2025年b;夏等人,2026年;张等人,2026年;林等人,2026年),而电子商务图像制作为指导驱动编辑提供了特别宝贵的应用. 在现代电子商务平台上,每种产品都可能需要许多展示图像:在不同模型上和不同姿势上展示的服装、贴在各种场景上的产品、突出销售点的宣传海报、或为目录进行清洁剪切。 手工制作这些图像缓慢且昂贵,音量随着目录的大小而增长,这使得自动化,指令驱动的编辑成为商家有吸引力和有价值的工具(杨等人,2024年;王等人,2021年).

blocks.en: Despite this promise, general-purpose editors do not directly meet the demands of commercial image production. E-commerce editing is governed by requirements that generic benchmarks neither isolate nor reward. The product itself must remain faithful across a large change of background, pose, or viewpoint, since any drift in shape, color, texture, or brand identity misrepresents the item being sold ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Text on product images, including prices, promotions, and selling points, must be rendered legibly and correctly, and even small glyph-level errors are immediately visible to shoppers ( Tuo et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Garment tasks such as virtual try-on impose their own constraints on fit, drape, and material fidelity, and they require reasoning jointly over more than one reference image ( Choi et al., 2024 ) . Above all, the ultimate measure of a commercial image is whether it attracts users, a property that is not fully captured by generic perceptual quality and that a general editor is not trained to optimize ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . These requirements are largely absent from the data, the objectives, and the evaluation protocols on which general editing models are built.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这一承诺,但通用编辑器并不能直接满足商业图像制作的需求. 电子商务编辑工作遵循的条件是,通用基准既不孤立也不奖励。 产品本身必须忠实于背景、姿势或观点的巨大变化,因为任何形状、颜色、纹理或品牌特征的漂移都歪曲了所出售的物品(Li等人,2026年b)。 关于产品图像的文字,包括价格,促销,以及销售点,必须做到直截了当,而且连小的甘油级错误也立即可见于购物者(Tuo等人,2024;Wang等人,2026a). 虚拟试穿等服装任务将自身束缚束缚在了合身,衣巾,和物质忠贞上,需要联合推理超过一个参考图像(Choi等人,2024年). 最重要的是,一个商业形象的最终衡量标准是它是否吸引用户,这个财产没有被一般的知觉质量完全捕捉到,而且一个总编辑没有经过优化的培训(Wang等人,2021年;杨等人,2024年). 这些数据、目标和一般编辑模式所依据的评价协议基本上没有这些要求。

blocks.en: We identify three obstacles that stand between a capable general editor and a production-grade e-commerce editing system. First, high-quality training data for the domain is scarce: e-commerce editing spans many specialized tasks, real product photography is noisy and unevenly distributed across categories, and constructing clean, instruction-aligned editing pairs at scale requires filtering, generation, and annotation far beyond what a fixed public corpus provides ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Second, standard training objectives do not target the domain-critical properties above. Supervised fine-tuning on imitation data teaches instruction following but does not directly optimize product identity preservation, text correctness, or commercial appeal. Third, existing benchmarks measure broad editing competence rather than the requirements of commercial image production, making it difficult to assess a model’s suitability for real-world e-commerce workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们找出了有能力的总编辑和生产级电子商务编辑系统之间的三个障碍。 首先,该领域的高质量培训数据很少:电子商务编辑跨越许多专门任务,真实产品摄影吵闹且在各类别之间分布不均,建造清洁的、与教学相匹配的编辑对应的规模要求过滤、生成和注释远远超出固定公共实体提供的范围(Wei等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年)。 第二,标准培训目标不针对上述领域关键特性。 监督对仿真数据的微调,教导遵循但并不直接优化产品身份保存,文本正确性,或商业吸引力. 第三,现有基准衡量的是广泛的编辑能力,而不是商业图像制作的要求,因此很难评估一个模型是否适合现实世界的电子商务工作流程。

blocks.en: Addressing these challenges requires coordinated design across data construction, model alignment, and evaluation. We therefore introduce KwaiMind , an instruction-based image editing system for e-commerce that brings these elements together through three tightly connected components.
blocks.zh: 要应对这些挑战,就必须在数据构建、模型调整和评价方面进行协调设计。 因此,我们引入了KwaiMind系统,这是一个基于指令的电子商务图像编辑系统,通过三个紧密相连的组成部分将这些要素汇集在一起。

blocks.en: We construct training data with a multi-agent pipeline that turns raw and generated imagery into clean, instruction-aligned editing pairs at scale ( section 2 ). A Filter Agent enforces data quality through an online pre-filter over intrinsic image properties and a simulated-human post-filter that approximates human review, a Generation Agent repairs rejected samples and synthesizes data for under-covered tasks, a Caption Agent produces hierarchical instructions and verifies them through a reverse-audit loop, and a Coordinator Agent schedules the whole process as an auditable, closed-loop state machine with human intervention reserved for high-value and boundary cases. The engine produces domain-concentrated, quality-controlled data across the full range of e-commerce editing tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个多剂管道构建培训数据,将原始图像和生成的图像转化为规模化的、与指示一致的编辑对(第2节)。 过滤器代理通过在线预过滤器对内在图像属性进行强制数据质量检查,模拟人后过滤器对人体审查进行近似,一代代理修复拒绝样本,并合成覆盖不足任务的数据,Caption代理制作分级指令并通过反向审计环路进行验证,协调员代理将整个过程作为可审计的闭锁状态机器,保留用于高价值和边界案件。 该引擎在整个电子商务编辑任务中产生域集中,质量控制的数据.

blocks.en: Following the architectural design of Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , we build on a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and adapt the model to the e-commerce domain through a staged pipeline of continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning from human feedback ( section 3 ). The Data Agent maintains approximately 1.8M high-quality training pairs spanning general and e-commerce editing. Continued pre-training uses the subset above 720p, together with instruction augmentation, to develop high-resolution editing capabilities across both domains. Supervised fine-tuning then refines editing precision on a task-balanced corpus curated by the Data Agent, comprising 115.0K general editing pairs and 119.9K e-commerce pairs selected under stricter criteria for instruction accuracy, content preservation, and visual quality. The alignment stage is where the domain-critical objectives are optimized directly. We first apply Direct Preference Optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ) in a mixed offline and online regime, then run online reinforcement learning on the forward diffusion process, driven by a vision-language judge for general edits and by three dedicated reward models that target the properties general rewards miss: a click-through rate model for commercial appeal, a coarse-to-fine reward for visual text rendering, and a consistency reward for product and model identity preservation Li et al. (2026b) ; Wang et al. (2026c) . Because each objective is optimized most effectively on its own, we finally consolidate the specialized policies into a single model through on-policy distillation, yielding one editor that inherits all capabilities without cross-task interference.
blocks.zh: 继Quen-Image(Wu等人,2025年a)的建筑设计之后,我们以多式联运变形器(MMDIT)(Esser等人,2024年)为基础,通过分阶段的继续预训、监督微调和从人类反馈中强化学习,使模型适应电子商务领域(第3节)。 数据代理公司维持着大约1.8M的高质量培训组合,涵盖一般和电子商务编辑。 继续预训使用720p以上的子集,以及指令增强,发展两个领域的高分辨率编辑能力. 监督微调后,对由数据代理公司负责的任务平衡套件的编辑精度进行了改进,包括根据更严格的指导精度、内容保存和视觉质量标准选择的115.0K一般编辑配对和119.9K电子商务配对。 调整阶段是直接优化域关键目标的地方。 我们首先将直接优待优化(Rafailov等人,2023年;Wallace等人,2024年)采用离线和在线混合制度,然后在视觉语言法官为一般编辑所驱动和针对属性一般奖励失利的3个专用奖励模式的推动下,进行前期传播过程的在线强化学习:商业上诉的点击率模式,视觉文本渲染的粗略至精细奖励,产品和模式身份保护Li等人的一致奖励(2026b);Wang等人(2026c). 因为每个目标都是靠自己最有效优化的,所以我们最终通过政策提炼将专门政策整合为单一模式,产生一个编辑器,在不受跨任务干扰的情况下继承所有能力.

blocks.en: We introduce Ecom-Bench , an evaluation suite purpose-built for e-commerce image editing ( section 4 ). It covers 11 representative tasks spanning garment and wearable editing, composition and layout, text operations, and appearance transfer, and it scores each task with a behavior-anchored, per-task selection of general and e-commerce-specific dimensions under a geometric-mean protocol that penalizes any single critical defect. Beyond judge-based scores, Ecom-Bench reports a learned click-through rate score that estimates the commercial attractiveness of a generated image. Alongside Ecom-Bench, we evaluate on established general-domain image editing benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Ecom-Bench, 为电子商务图像编辑专门设计的评价套件(第4节)。 它包括11项具有代表性的任务,涉及服装和可穿戴的编辑、组成和布局、文字操作和外观转移,它通过一种几何-平均值协议对每项任务进行行为障碍、一般和电子商务特定层面的每个任务选择,对任何单一的关键缺陷进行惩罚。 Ecom-Bench除了基于法官的分数外,还报告一个有学识的点击率分数,估计一个生成的图像的商业吸引力. 除了Ecom-Bench之外,我们还根据既定的一般域图像编辑基准进行评估。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows. • We present an agent-based data engine that automates filtering, targeted generation, hierarchical captioning, and coordination into a closed-loop system for producing high-quality e-commerce editing data at scale. • We adapt a strong open-source editor to the e-commerce domain with an alignment stage that combines mixed offline and online preference optimization, forward-process reinforcement learning, and three e-commerce reward models for commercial appeal, text rendering, and identity consistency, consolidated into a single model by on-policy distillation. • We introduce Ecom-Bench, an 11-task benchmark with domain-tailored, behavior-anchored metrics and a learned click-through rate score, providing an evaluation protocol aligned with the requirements of commercial image production.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下。 我们提出一个基于代理的数据引擎,将过滤、定向生成、分级标题和协调自动化成一个闭路系统,以大规模生成高质量的电子商务编辑数据。 我们把一个强大的开源编辑器适应于电子商务领域,配有一个调和阶段,结合混合离线和在线优惠优化,前期流程强化学习,以及商业吸引力,文本渲染和身份一致性三个电子商务奖励模式,通过政策提炼整合为单一模式. ^ 我们引入了Ecom-Bench,这是一个11个任务基准,包含域名,行为-焦虑的度量衡和学习的点击率分数,提供了符合商业图像制作要求的评价协议.

blocks.en: We present an agent-based data engine that automates filtering, targeted generation, hierarchical captioning, and coordination into a closed-loop system for producing high-quality e-commerce editing data at scale.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个基于代理的数据引擎,将过滤、目标生成、分级标题和协调自动化成一个可大规模生成高质量电子商务编辑数据的闭路系统。

blocks.en: We adapt a strong open-source editor to the e-commerce domain with an alignment stage that combines mixed offline and online preference optimization, forward-process reinforcement learning, and three e-commerce reward models for commercial appeal, text rendering, and identity consistency, consolidated into a single model by on-policy distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们为电子商务领域调整了强大的开源编辑器,其配对阶段结合了混合离线和在线优惠优化,前期流程强化学习,以及商业吸引力,文本渲染,身份一致性三个电子商务奖励模式,通过政策提炼整合为一个单一模式.

blocks.en: We introduce Ecom-Bench, an 11-task benchmark with domain-tailored, behavior-anchored metrics and a learned click-through rate score, providing an evaluation protocol aligned with the requirements of commercial image production.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Ecom-Bench,这是一个11个任务基准,包含域名,行为-焦虑的度量衡和学习的点击率分数,提供了符合商业图像制作要求的评价协议.

blocks.en: 2 Data
blocks.zh: 2 数据

blocks.en: This section will describe the agent-based system for filtering, generating, annotating, and coordinating training data.
blocks.zh: 本节将介绍基于代理人的系统,用于过滤、生成、注释和协调培训数据。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Agent
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据代理

blocks.en: Data Agent is a multi-agent collaborative system for producing image-editing data. Coordinated by Coordinator Agent and jointly executed with the Filter, Generation, and Caption Agents, with human reviewers serving as a fallback at critical checkpoints, it transforms raw materials end-to-end into high-quality source-target-caption triplets, while simultaneously producing the evaluator dataset used to iterate the simulated-human VLM evaluator.
blocks.zh: 数据代理是制作图像编辑数据的多代理协作系统. 它由协调员代理公司协调,与过滤器、生成器和控制代理公司联合执行,在关键检查站充当倒计时器,将原材料端到端转换成高质量的源目标封装三重体,同时生成用于标定模拟人VLM评价器的评价数据集。

blocks.en: 2.1.1 System Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 系统结构

blocks.en: The system comprises four collaborating sub-agents. All Skills are uniformly registered in the Skill Registry for dynamic invocation, and human reviewers are explicitly involved at critical checkpoints to handle boundary and failure cases.
blocks.zh: 该系统由四个协作子代理组成。 所有技能都统一登记在技能登记处,以便动态引用,人力审查员明确参与重要检查站处理边界和故障案件。

blocks.en: The global scheduling hub. It maintains the sample lifecycle through a finite state machine, drives the sub-agents with standardized work orders, and manages loop budgets, gap-triggered supplementary generation, and the accumulation of strategy experience.
blocks.zh: 全球调度枢纽. 它通过有限的状态机维持样本生命周期,以标准化的工作订单驱动子代理,并管理循环预算,漏洞触发的补充生成,以及战略经验的积累.

blocks.en: The data quality gatekeeper. Pre-Filter removes low-quality and non-compliant samples before annotation under two collaboration modes, Voter and Aspect. Post-Filter, applied after annotation, scores each sample along three criteria with a simulated-human VLM evaluator that iterates on itself.
blocks.zh: 数据质量守门员. Pre-Filter在用投票人和Aspect两种协作模式进行注释前会移除质量低且不符合要求的样本. 在注释后应用的Filter后,按照三个标准对每个样本进行评分,并配备一个模拟-人类VLM评价员,该评价员在自己身上进行检测。

blocks.en: The data remediation and completion component. The Modification branch repairs recoverable samples based on diagnostic reports, and the Supplement branch fills subtask gaps. An LLM Planner performs task parsing and Skill routing, and the actual generation is carried out by four categories of expert models.
blocks.zh: 数据补救和完成部分。 修改处根据诊断报告修复可收回的样品,补充处填补子任务空白。 一个LLM计划员执行任务剖析和技能路线,实际生成由四类专家模型进行.

blocks.en: The textual annotation component. It produces three-tiered hierarchical captions for each sample, uses difference-mask guidance to direct the VLM toward the edited regions, and verifies annotation quality through a closed-loop reverse audit performed by an LLM.
blocks.zh: 文字注释组件。 它为每个样本制作三级分级标题,使用差异矩阵指导将VLM引导到经编辑的区域,并通过LLM进行的闭路反向审计验证注释质量.

blocks.en: 2.2 Filter Agent
blocks.zh: 2.2 过滤剂

blocks.en: Filter Agent serves as the core component responsible for data filtering and quality control. It is divided into two stages according to its position in the pipeline. Pre-Filter focuses on intrinsic image quality, removing low-quality, non-compliant, or duplicate samples before images enter the annotation stage. Post-Filter simulates human review by performing fine-grained evaluation on data tuples with generated captions, approximating human review capability and continuously accumulating training data for downstream model iteration.
blocks.zh: 过滤剂是负责数据过滤和质量控制的核心组成部分。 它根据其在管道中的位置分为两个阶段. Pre-Filter专注于内在的图像质量,在图像进入注释阶段前去除低质量,不符合要求,或者重复样本. Filter后模拟了人类审查,方法是用生成的字幕对数据扭矩进行精细评价,近似人类审查能力,不断积累下游模型迭代的培训数据。

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Pre-Filter

Each Pre-Filter Skill uses either Voter or Aspect collaboration. Voter mode handles holistic judgments such as AIGC and anime detection or content compliance. It invokes K K heterogeneous VLMs in parallel and adopts the majority verdict; when no majority exists, a Judge model aggregates their verdicts and rationales Wang et al. (2022) ; Zheng et al. (2023) . Aspect mode handles composite criteria such as perceptual quality, aesthetics, and product-task consistency. It decomposes each criterion into N N approximately orthogonal aspects evaluated by independent prompts or dedicated detectors, followed by weighted aggregation with a Judge model Song et al. (2024) . All Skills output an evidence chain and one of four verdicts: Passed , Rejected-Recoverable , Rejected-Unrecoverable , or Uncertain . These verdicts map to the PreFilter-{Passed, Recoverable, Rejected, Uncertain} states. At the Pre-Filter stage, Uncertain denotes voter disagreement, contradictory aspect evidence, or low confidence.
blocks.zh: 每个预选者技能都使用选民或旁观者的合作. 选民模式处理AIGC和动漫检测或内容合规等整体判断. 它平行地援引K K 各种VLM, 并采纳多数判决;在没有多数的情况下,法官模型汇总了他们的判决和理由:Wang等人(2022年);Zheng等人(2023年)。 光谱模式处理综合标准,如感知质量,美学,以及产品任务的一致性. 它将每个标准分解成N N 大约正交方面,由独立的提示器或专用探测器评估,然后用Song等人(2024年)法官模型进行加权汇总。 所有技能都输出一个证据链和四个判决中的一个:通过、拒绝可恢复、拒绝不可恢复或不确定。 这些裁决映射到 PreFilter - {Passed, Recovery, recredited, unsure} 状态 。 在投票前阶段,不确定性表示选民意见不一,存在矛盾的方面证据,或者信心不足。

blocks.en: We implement four Pre-Filter Skills. Deduplication, basic visual feature filtering, consistency filtering, and the perceptual quality and aesthetics sub-Skill use Aspect mode. The AIGC and anime detection and content compliance sub-Skills use Voter mode.
blocks.zh: 我们实施四种预测试技能。 复制,基本视觉特征过滤,一致性过滤,以及知觉质量和美学子技能使用Aspect模式. AIGC和动漫检测和内容合规子技能使用Voter模式.

blocks.en: 1. Deduplication. Global deduplication uses CLIP embeddings Radford et al. (2021) for nearest-neighbor retrieval and clustering. Edit-pair deduplication combines CLIP similarity with PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018) to remove near-identity pairs Team et al. (2026) . 2. Basic visual feature filtering. Thresholds on saturation, brightness, and RGB entropy remove under-exposed, over-exposed, color-distorted, and near-uniform images Team et al. (2026) . For e-commerce data, CTR signals further exclude images with poor historical performance. 3. Compliance filtering. This Skill comprises three sub-Skills. (1) AIGC and anime detection excludes images with a pronounced AI-generated appearance and anime-style images. (2) Perceptual quality and aesthetics assessment evaluates blur, noise, exposure, physical anomalies, composition, color harmony, watermarks, and text overlays. (3) Content compliance review uses multi-model voting to detect nudity, graphic violence, and other prohibited content and produces an auditable rejection report. 4. Consistency filtering. For editing pairs involving products, persons, and related subjects, this Skill checks category, subject identity, and core visual attributes between source and target images.
blocks.zh: 1. 重复。 全球分解使用CLIP嵌入Radford等人(2021年)进行近邻检索和集群. Edit-pair deduplation结合了CLIP的相似性与PSNR,SSIM,以及LPIPS Zhang等人(2018年),以去除近身份配对Team等人(2026年). 2. 基本视觉特征过滤。 对饱和度、亮度和RGB  en的阈值将曝光度不足、曝光度过高、颜色扭曲和近乎单一的图像删除 Team等人(2026年). 对于电子商务数据,CTR信号进一步排除了历史性能不佳的图像. 3. 合规过滤。 这一技能包括三个子技能。 (1)AIGC和动漫探测排除了带有显著AI生成的外观和动漫风格图像的图像. (2)观念质量和美学评估评价模糊,噪声,暴露,物理异常,组成,色彩和谐,水印,文字覆盖. (3)内容合规审查采用多模式投票方式,检测裸体,图形暴力等违禁内容,产生可审计的拒绝报告. 4. 一致性过滤。 对于涉及产品,人物,及相关主体的编辑对子,本技能检查类别,主体身份,以及源图像与目标图像之间的核心视觉属性.

(2) Perceptual quality and aesthetics assessment evaluates blur, noise, exposure, physical anomalies, composition, color harmony, watermarks, and text overlays. (3) Content compliance review uses multi-model voting to detect nudity, graphic violence, and other prohibited content and produces an auditable rejection report.

blocks.zh: 一致性过滤. 对于涉及产品,人物,及相关主体的编辑对子,本技能检查类别,主体身份,以及源图像与目标图像之间的核心视觉属性.

blocks.en: Each verdict includes routing metadata. Passed records confidence; Rejected-Recoverable records rejection reasons, recovery hints, and evidence chains; Rejected-Unrecoverable records rejection categories; and Uncertain records the disagreement source and aggregate confidence. Coordinator routes samples using these fields. Batch-level reports record pass rates, Skill-level rejection distributions, aspect scores, collaboration disagreement, and sampled positive and negative cases for data monitoring and Skill updates.
blocks.zh: 每个判决包括路由元数据. 通过了记录置信度; 拒绝的可收回记录拒绝理由, 恢复提示, 和证据链; 拒绝的不可收回记录拒绝类别; 和 不确定记录分歧的来源和累积置信度. 协调员利用这些领域进行取样。 批量级报告记录通过率,技能级拒绝分布,侧面分数,协作分歧,并抽查数据监测和技能更新的正负案例.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Post-Filter

Post-Filter applies a simulated-human VLM evaluator to captioned tuples of a source image, target image, and caption. Following FireRed Team et al. (2026) , it evaluates three dimensions. (1) Instruction consistency measures whether the source-to-target change correctly and completely follows the caption without extraneous edits. (2) Edit consistency measures preservation outside the intended edit region, including subject identity. (3) Perceptual quality measures sharpness, artifacts, and aesthetics. For each dimension, the evaluator outputs a score on a 1–10 scale, together with confidence and a rationale. It then assigns Accepted , Rejected , Uncertain , or OOD , corresponding to the PostFilter-{Accepted, Rejected, Uncertain, OOD} states. Uncertain denotes an in-distribution sample with contradictory dimension scores or confidence below a preset threshold. OOD denotes an input outside the evaluator’s supported distribution. Both states are routed to human review.
blocks.zh: Post-Filter将模拟人类VLM评价器应用于源图像、目标图像和标题的图案。 继FireRed Team等人(2026年)之后,它评价了三个维度. (1)指示一致性衡量源对目标是否正确和完全按照标题进行修改,而不进行外在编辑. (2)在预定编辑区域之外编辑一致性措施保存,包括主题身份。 (3)观念质量衡量锐度,文物,美学. 评价人员对每个方面都得出1至10级的评分,并附上信心和理由。 它然后指定接受、拒绝、不确定或OOD,对应“后Filter-{接受、拒绝、不确定、OOD}状态。 不确定表示分布中样本的维度分数或信心相矛盾,低于预先设定的阈值. OOD表示在评价员支持的分布之外的投入. 两个州都经过人文审查.

blocks.en: Evaluator training data comes from four sources. Positive samples are high-confidence Accepted outputs from the current evaluator. Auto-constructed negatives are generated by an LLM through controlled perturbations of attributes, subjects, operations, or categories in Accepted samples Team et al. (2026) . Human samples include reviewed contrastive pairs and manually corrupted samples. Pre-Filter negatives are high-confidence, low-disagreement samples rejected by Pre-Filter in Section 2.2.1 . The evaluator is updated through prompt revision with high-value errors and accumulated experience as few-shot examples, and through supervised fine-tuning. Updates are manually deployed when the accumulated samples reach a preset threshold and offline validation shows no performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 评价员培训数据来自四个来源。 阳性样本是当前评价者的高度信心接受产出。 自动构造的底物由LLM通过受接受样本组等人(2026年)对属性、主体、操作或类别进行控制扰动生成。 人类样本包括经审查的对比对和人工腐蚀的样本. 预Filter阴性是前Filter在第2.2.1节中拒绝的高度自信,低分歧的样本. 评价人员通过及时修订高价值错误和积累经验作为少见的例子,并通过监督微调加以更新。 当累积的样本达到预先设定的阈值,并且离线验证显示没有性能退化时,更新会手动部署.

blocks.en: 2.3 Generation Agent
blocks.zh: 2.3 生成代理

blocks.en: Generation Agent performs Modification and Supplement. Modification repairs samples marked as Rejected-Recoverable by Pre-Filter, while Supplement fills subtask gaps detected by Coordinator Agent. In both branches, an LLM Planner routes each work order to an expert model or API. The expert produces multiple candidates, from which the highest-scoring result is retained. Each output records its execution path, expert models, intermediate boxes or masks, and prompts. Modified samples enter the Generated-Modified state with a region mask for local Pre-Filter, whereas supplementary samples enter the Generated-Supplement state and undergo full-image Pre-Filter. Modification is limited to N N rounds, and samples exceeding this budget are routed to the human review queue.
blocks.zh: 生成代理执行修改和补充。 修改修复样本被标记为预过滤器可回收的拒绝,而补充则填补协调员代理发现的子任务漏洞. 在两个分支中,一个LLM计划员将每个工作订单引导到一个专家模型或API. 专家产生多个候选人,从中保留得分最高的成绩. 每个输出记录其执行路径,专家模型,中间箱或口罩,以及提示. 修改后的样本进入生成-修改状态时带有区域掩码,用于本地预筛选,而补充的样本进入生成-补充状态并接受全图像预筛选. 修改仅限于N型N轮,超过这个预算的样本被送入人类审查队列.

blocks.en: 2.3.1 LLM Planner
blocks.zh: 2.3.1 LLM 规划员

blocks.en: The LLM Planner converts each work order into an executable plan through three steps: (1) Diagnostic parsing. For Modification, it extracts repair targets from the rejection reasons, recovery hints, and evidence chain, including missing subjects, attribute mismatches, and unintended edits. For Supplement, it determines the target subtask, scene constraints, and diversity requirements from the gap list and dataset distribution. This step is omitted when the work order already specifies the target scene. (2) Skill routing. The Planner inserts localization or segmentation before spatially constrained tasks such as replace, remove, and change-background. It then selects a Skill according to task type, scene complexity, and the Skill capability profile. Expert models remain fixed within each Skill and are not exposed to the Planner. (3) Prompt generation. The Planner generates semantically equivalent and lexically diverse prompts for the selected Skill to reduce mode collapse Brooks et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 法学硕士 计划员通过三个步骤将每个工作命令转换为可执行计划: (1) 诊断分析。 对于修改,它从拒绝理由中提取修复目标,恢复提示,以及证据链,包括缺失的主题,属性错配,以及意想不到的编辑. 对于补编,它确定目标子任务,场景限制,以及差距列表和数据集分布中的多样性要求. 当工作命令已经指定目标场景时,此步骤会被省略. (2)技能路线. 规划师在空间限制的任务(如替换、删除和改变背景)之前插入本地化或分区化。 然后它根据任务类型,场景复杂度,以及技能能力简介来选择一个技能. 专家模型在每种技能中保持不变,不接触规划师。 (3) 迅速生成。 Planner为选定的Skill公司生成模拟等效和逻辑多样性的提示,以减少模式崩溃的Brooks等人(2023年)。

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Expert Execution
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 专家处决

blocks.en: For composite edits, the Skill layer follows the Task Splitting mechanism in FireRed Team et al. (2026) . A VLM decomposes each instruction into ordered atomic operations, and the Router sequentially invokes the corresponding experts to reduce per-step complexity and preserve structure. We group these experts by control signal: (1) Instruction-driven editing. FLUX.2 Black Forest Labs (2025) and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 Wu et al. (2025a) handle general edits, LongCat-Image Meituan LongCat Team et al. (2025) handles dense Chinese text, and Seedream and NanoBanana-2 handle complex multimodal instructions. (2) Perception. GroundingDINO Liu et al. (2024) , SAM2 Ravi et al. (2025) , and RMBG-2.0 Zheng et al. (2024) provide bounding boxes, masks, and foreground separation for spatially constrained edits. (3) Structured-control editing. Mask-conditioned FLUX.2 and SDXL-Inpainting Podell et al. (2024) perform localized edits, while DWPose Yang et al. (2023b) provides keypoints for pose transfer. (4) Deterministic synthesis. We use 3D parametric templates, structured layout templates, and deterministic image-processing operators Team et al. (2026) for color transfer, sharpening, layout control, and parametric pose or expression control. This group also serves as a fallback and a supplementary data source.
blocks.zh: 对于复合编辑,技能层遵循FireRed Team等人(2026年)中的任务划分机制. VLM将每个指令分解成有序的原子操作,路由器依次引用相应的专家来降低每步复杂度和维护结构. 我们用控制信号把这些专家集合起来: (1)指导性编辑. FLUX.2 黑森林实验室(2025)和Quen-Image-Edit-2511 Wu等人(2025a)处理一般编辑,LongCat-Image Meituan LongCat Team等. (2025)处理稠密的中文文本,而Seedream和NanoBanana-2处理复杂的多式联运指令. (2)观念. 地面导航 刘等人(2024年),SAM2 Ravi等人(2025年),以及人民币G-0. (2024)为空间受限编辑提供边框,口罩,和前景隔离. (3)结构化控制编辑. 带面具的FLUX.2和SDXL-Inpainting Podell等人(2024年)进行局部编辑,而DWPose Yang等人(2023年b年)则提供姿势转移的关键点. (4)决定性合成. 我们使用3D参数模板、结构化布局模板和定型图像处理操作器 Team et al. (2026)用于色调传导,磨削,布局控制,以及参数化姿势或表达控制. 这一组还充当了倒计时和补充数据来源。

blocks.en: 2.4 Caption Agent
blocks.zh: 2.4 说明代理人

blocks.en: Caption Agent annotates images and editing pairs marked as Passed by Pre-Filter through hierarchical captioning, mask-guided prompting, and bounded reverse auditing. The VLM produces three captions for each sample: (1) Detailed caption. It describes the image content for text-to-image data or the attribute, spatial, and semantic changes in an editing pair. (2) Concise caption. An LLM compresses the detailed caption using randomly sampled syntactic structures from multiple VLMs and lexicons to reduce template bias Singla et al. (2024) . (3) Simulated-user caption. The LLM rewrites the concise caption as a colloquial, help-seeking instruction. For editing pairs, we compute an approximate change mask from the pixel-level difference between the source and target images. The mask is overlaid on the target image and encoded as Set-of-Mark boxes and indices in the prompt Yang et al. (2023a) . This directs the VLM to describe edited regions, including small object replacements, local tagline removal, and text modification.
blocks.zh: Caption Agent通过分级标题,遮罩制导提示,以及边框反向审计,将图像和编辑配对标记为Pre-Filter通过的. VLM为每个样本制作三个标题: (1) 详细标题。 它描述了文本到图像数据的图像内容或编辑配对中的属性,空间,语义变化. (2) 简明标题。 LLM利用从多个VLM和词典中随机抽取的合成结构来压缩详细标题,以减少模板偏差Singla等人(2024年). (3) 模拟用户标题。 LLM 将简洁的字幕重写为拼图, 求援指令 。 对于编辑配对,我们计算出源与目标图像之间像素级差异的近似变化掩码. 口罩在目标图像上覆盖,并编码为Set-Of-Mark boxs和索引于please Yang et al. (2023a). 这指示VLM描述编辑区域,包括小对象替换,本地标记线删除,以及文本修改.

blocks.en: After captioning, a reverse audit checks semantic accuracy following a generate-then-verify procedure Wu et al. (2025c) . Given only the caption, an LLM infers the expected visual content and compares its key slots with the known metadata. Any mismatch is added to the prompt for caption regeneration. The loop terminates when the audit passes or reaches N N rounds Madaan et al. (2023) ; remaining failures are forwarded by the Coordinator for human review.
blocks.zh: 在标题之后,通过生成-当时验证程序对Wu等人(2025c)进行反向审计检查语义准确性。 仅从标题来看,LLM会推断预期的视觉内容,并将其键位与已知元数据进行比较。 任何不匹配都添加到标题再生的提示中 。 当审计通过或达到N轮Madaan等人(2023年)时,循环即告终止;其余的失败则由人力审查协调员转交。

blocks.en: 2.5 Coordinator Agent
blocks.zh: 2.5 协调员

blocks.en: Coordinator Agent maintains the global dataset state, schedules sample batches, and dispatches standardized work orders across sub-agents. It also manages loop budgets and human-review entry points. Each work order records its branch triggers for reproducibility and auditing.
blocks.zh: 协调员 Agent维持全局数据集状态,调度样本批量,并跨子代理发送标准化的工作订单. 它还管理循环预算和人力审查切入点。 每一工作命令都记录其分支的可复制性和审计触发器。

blocks.en: 2.5.1 State Machine and Work Orders
blocks.zh: 2.5.1 国家机器和工作命令

blocks.en: Coordinator tracks each sample through the finite state machine in Table 1 . Every state transition emits a work order containing the source and target states, rejection reason, evidence chain, execution path, and metadata. The pipeline contains two feedback loops: Pre-Filter with Modification and Caption with Reverse-Audit. Both loops are capped at N N rounds. Samples exceeding the loop budget enter the corresponding stage-specific Escalated state and are routed to human review.
blocks.zh: 协调员通过表1中的有限状态机器跟踪每个样本。 每个州过渡都发出一个包含源和目标状态,拒绝理由,证据链,执行路径和元数据的工作命令. 管道包含两个反馈循环:带有修改的预筛选和带有反向审计的描述. 两种环绕均在N N 回合时封顶. 超过循环预算的样本进入相应的阶段性升级状态,并被引导到人类审查.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Sample states maintained by Coordinator Agent. Each state determines the next work-order destination. States ending in Escalated indicate that the corresponding loop budget has been exhausted and human review is required.
blocks.zh: 表1:协调员代理保持的样本状态。 每个州决定下一个工作订单目的地. 以Escaled案结束的国家表示,相应的循环预算已经用尽,需要进行人文审查。

blocks.en: 2.5.2 Scheduling Memory
blocks.zh: 2.5.2 时间安排记忆

blocks.en: Coordinator maintains loop memory and an experience buffer. Loop memory records each sample’s iteration count and rejection sequence for budget control and stopping. The experience buffer stores representative successes and failures, human verdicts, and automatically constructed negatives for Skill prompt updates and SFT training. This design combines per-sample loop state with cross-batch experience Zhang et al. (2025) . For Supplement, Coordinator periodically checks subtask coverage, category distribution, and diversity against preset thresholds. Detected gaps trigger Supplement work orders to Generation Agent. All scheduling decisions follow a work-order-based ReAct loop Yao et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 协调员维持循环内存和体验缓冲器。 循环内存记录每个样本的迭代数和预算控制和停止的拒绝序列 。 经验缓冲器存储了代表性的成败,人类判断,并自动构建了Skill即时更新和SFT训练的负数. 这种设计结合了每例循环状态与交叉批次体验的张等(2025). 为补充,协调员定期对照预先设定的门槛值检查次级任务的覆盖范围、类别分布和多样性。 探测到的漏洞触发 工作订单补充生成代理。 所有排程决定都遵循基于工作订单的ReAct role Yao等人(2022年).

blocks.en: 2.5.3 Human-in-the-Loop

Human intervention occurs at three entry points: (1) Milestone review. After each high-cost stage, Coordinator reports the batch pass rate, Skill-level rejection distribution, subtask-level pass rate, and disagreement by collaboration mode. Representative accepted, rejected, and boundary samples are included for approval before the next stage. (2) Exception handling. Uncertain samples from either filtering stage, Post-Filter OOD samples, loop-budget overflows, and operational threshold violations are routed to human review. Reviewers resolve these cases and annotate boundary samples. (3) Iteration decisions. Reviewers select samples for the experience buffer, Skill prompt updates, or SFT training. They also trigger retraining and deployment of the simulated-human VLM evaluator.
blocks.zh: 人类干预发生在三个切入点: (1) 里程碑审查。 在每个高成本阶段后,协调员报告批次通过率,技能级拒绝率分配,子任务级通过率,以及合作模式的分歧. 代表接受,拒绝,在下一阶段前列入边界样品供批准. (2)例外处理。 从过滤阶段、Filter后OD样本、循环预算溢出以及操作阈值违反的不确定样本,都交由人审查。 审查人员解决这些案件,并标注边界样本。 (3) 重审决定。 审查者为经验缓冲、技能即时更新或SFT培训选择样本。 它们也触发模拟-人类甚高频评价员的再培训和部署。

blocks.en: 2.6 End-to-End Data Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.6 端对端 数据管道

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Overview of the end-to-end data pipeline. Coordinator Agent routes samples through filtering, generation, captioning, and post-filtering with bounded feedback loops and human review.
blocks.zh: 图4:端对端数据管道概况. 协调员Agent通过过滤、生成、字幕和带有限定反馈循环和人类审查的过滤后跟踪样本。

blocks.en: Figure 4 summarizes the end-to-end pipeline. Coordinator uses its state machine to route sample batches through Pre-Filter, Generation, Caption, and Post-Filter, with the Skill Registry providing shared capabilities. The pipeline produces the main training set and an evaluator dataset for iterative VLM evaluator updates.
blocks.zh: 图4汇总了端到端管道. 协调员使用其状态机器通过预Filter,生成,Caption和后Filter传送样本批次,技能登记处提供共享能力. 管道制作主要培训集和一套评价数据集,供迭代甚高频评价员更新。

blocks.en: Pre-Filter routes Passed samples to Caption Agent, Rejected-Recoverable samples with diagnostic reports to Modification, and Uncertain samples to human review. Rejected-Unrecoverable samples are archived, with high-confidence cases added to the evaluator dataset. Supplement addresses subtask gaps detected by Coordinator, and all Generation outputs return to Pre-Filter. Caption Agent applies a bounded generation, reverse-audit, and revision loop before qualified source-image, target-image, and caption triplets enter Post-Filter. High-confidence Accepted samples enter the training-set ingestion queue, while high-confidence Rejected samples and automatically perturbed hard negatives are archived as evaluator negatives. Post-Filter Uncertain and OOD samples are routed to human review. Accepted and rejected outputs also update the evaluator dataset. Coordinator enforces all loop budgets and routes milestone reports, exceptional or low-confidence samples, and on-demand inspections to human review. Human verdicts update pipeline states and evaluator data.
blocks.zh: 预Filter路线 将样本传递给Caption Agent, 拒绝可回收的样本与诊断报告到修改, 不确定的样本到人类审查。 拒绝的无法收回的样本存档,在评价数据集中增加了高度信任的病例。 补编涉及协调员发现的子任务缺口,所有世代的产出都返回预选阶段。 Caption Agent在合格的源映像,目标映像,标题三进进入Post-Filter之前,应用了限定生成,反向审计,以及修订循环. 高度自信 接受样品进入训练集摄入队列,而高自信的拒绝样品和自动扰动的硬底片则作为评价底片存档. 测试后不确定和OD样本被送入人体审查。 接受和拒绝的产出也更新了评价数据集。 协调员执行所有循环预算和路线里程碑报告、例外或低信心样本以及对人进行审查的点名检查。 人类判决更新了管道状态和评估数据。

blocks.en: 2.7 Dataset Scale and Final Composition
blocks.zh: 2.7 数据集规模和最终组成

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Composition of the curated SFT corpus. The upper half shows the
e-commerce subset and the lower half shows the general editing subset; surrounding
examples illustrate representative source–target pairs from different tasks.

blocks.en: We apply the Data Agent to a mixture of public editing datasets and proprietary Kwai pairs. These sources contain approximately 26.2M source–target examples before the final quality-control and deduplication stages. Through filtering, targeted modification of recoverable samples, and gap-driven supplementary generation, the Data Agent maintains approximately 1.8M high-quality training pairs for model development.
blocks.zh: 我们把数据代理应用到公共编辑数据集和专有的Kwai配对的混合体中. 这些来源包含大约26.2M源-目标实例,在最终质量控制和分解阶段之前。 通过过滤、有针对性地修改可回收样品和空隙驱动的补充生成,数据代理公司为模型开发保留了约1.8M型高质量培训配对。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Data sources processed by the Data Agent and the resulting maintained training corpus.
blocks.zh: 表2:数据代理机构处理的数据来源以及随后维持的培训机构。

blocks.en: Candidate editing pairs that pass Pre-Filter and complete captioning and reverse auditing enter Post-Filter, where instruction consistency, edit consistency, and perceptual quality are each scored on a 1–10 scale as defined in section 2.2.2 . Following the routing in section 2.6 , high-confidence Accepted triplets enter the training-set ingestion queue, while high-confidence Rejected samples are archived as evaluator negatives. The maintained training pairs are then selected according to their downstream role: broad high-resolution pairs support CT, while more selective and task-balanced subsets support SFT and final alignment. Modification repairs samples identified as recoverable by Pre-Filter; Supplement addresses task or visual-pattern gaps detected by Coordinator. Outputs from both branches return to Pre-Filter and proceed through captioning and Post-Filter before they can enter the training corpus.
blocks.zh: 候选人编辑对通过预选栏并完成字幕和反向审计进入后预选栏,其中指示一致性、编辑一致性和感知质量按第2.2.2节定义的1至10级评分。 在2.6节的路由之后,高自信接受三胞胎进入训练设置的摄入队列,而高自信拒绝的样本则作为评价底片存档. 随后根据下游角色选择保留的培训配对:宽高分辨率配对支持CT,而更具选择性和任务平衡的子集支持SFT和最终对齐. 修改修理样本经预过滤器确定可回收;补充材料涉及协调员发现的任务或可视的缺口。 两个处的产出都回到预选栏,然后通过字幕和预选栏进行,然后才能进入培训栏。

blocks.en: To prepare the data for supervised fine-tuning, we organize candidates from the maintained 1.8M-pair corpus by general and e-commerce editing tasks. We first filter candidate pairs using their recorded Post-Filter scores, then apply an additional round of task-specific screening with criteria tailored to each subtask across instruction accuracy, content preservation, and visual quality, alongside task balancing and quality auditing. This process yields 234.9K SFT pairs, comprising 115.0K general editing pairs covering atomic and compositional edits and 119.9K e-commerce pairs drawn from proprietary data collected from real merchant demands. The e-commerce subset spans 11 tasks grouped into three families: Garment & Wearable , Composition & Layout , and Text & Marketing . Figure 5 shows the task distribution of the curated SFT corpus, and the detailed selection criteria are provided in section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 为了编制数据进行监督的微调,我们按一般和电子商务编辑任务,从维持的1.8M-pair程序单中组织候选人。 我们首先用他们记录的“Filter”分数筛选候选人的对子,然后再进行一轮针对具体任务的筛选,并针对每个子任务制定标准,包括指令准确性、内容保存和视觉质量,同时进行任务平衡和质量审计。 这个过程产生234.9K SFT对,包括115.0K的普通编辑对,涵盖原子和组成编辑,以及119.9K的电子商务对,它们来自从真实商家需求中收集的专有数据. 电子商务子集包括11项任务,分为3个家庭: 服装和可穿戴、组成和布局以及文本和营销。 图5显示受保SFT程序的任务分布,详细选择标准见第3.3节。

blocks.en: Finally, we construct dedicated preference and reward-training subsets from the maintained corpus. We stratify e-commerce and general editing examples across the target tasks, while using additional expert-generated pairs when required to improve long-tail coverage. This staged reuse of the same quality-controlled pool supports CT, SFT, and final alignment without treating earlier filtered data as discarded.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们从所保存的文献中构建了专门的偏好和奖励培训子集。 我们将电子商务和一般编辑实例分解到目标任务中,同时在必要时使用额外的专家生成的对子,以提高长尾覆盖。 这种同质控制池的分阶段再利用支持CT,SFT,以及最终对齐,而不把早先过滤过的数据当作丢弃.

blocks.en: 3 Training
blocks.zh: 3 培训

blocks.en: We build our editing model on top of a strong open-source foundation Wu et al. (2025a) and adapt it through a staged pipeline comprising continued pre-training (CT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning from human feedback ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . CT combines instruction augmentation with a broad mixture of general and e-commerce editing pairs above 720p, prepared by the Data Agent, to develop high-resolution editing capabilities across both domains. SFT then refines instruction accuracy, content preservation, and visual quality using a task-balanced subset curated through score-based filtering and an additional round of screening with task-specific criteria across these three dimensions. The final alignment stage combines preference optimization, online reinforcement learning driven by task-specific reward models, and multi-task consolidation.
blocks.zh: 我们在强大的开源基础吴等人(2025a)之上构建编辑模型,并通过包括持续预训(CT),监督微调(SFT),以及强化从人类反馈学习(Wu等人,2026年)在内的分阶段管道加以改造. CT将指令增强与数据代理公司编写的720p以上的通用和电子商务编辑对的广泛混合,以发展两个领域的高分辨率编辑能力. 然后,SFT通过基于分数的筛选和另外一轮筛选,用一个任务平衡的子集来改进指令的准确性、内容保存和视觉质量,并有跨越这三个维度的任务特定标准。 最终的对接阶段结合了偏好优化,任务特定奖励模式驱动的在线强化学习,多任务整合.

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑

blocks.en: Our architecture follows Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 ( Wu et al., 2025a ) and is based on a double-stream Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) ( Esser et al., 2024 ) . Three input streams are concatenated into a single token sequence for dense bidirectional attention: latent tokens of the target image produced by a variational autoencoder (VAE) encoder ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , latent tokens of one or more reference images, and textual instruction embeddings produced by a vision-language encoder. Jointly processing the reference and target in a single stream enables each target token to attend to the reference content at every layer, a capability essential for preserving identity and layout in the editing tasks that predominate in commercial image production.
blocks.zh: 我们的建筑遵循 Wen-Image-Edit-2511(Wu等人,2025a),基于双流多式扩散变形器(MMDIT). (Esser等人,2024年). 三个输入流被组合成一个单一的符号序列,以进行密集的双向注意:一个变异自编码器(VAE)编码器(Rombach等人,2022年)生成的目标图像的潜在符号,一个或多个参考图像的潜在符号,以及一个视觉语言编码器生成的文本指令嵌入. 在一个单一流中联合处理参考和目标,使每个目标符号都能够注意每一层的参考内容,这种能力对于在商业图像制作中占主导地位的编辑任务中保持身份和布局至关重要。

blocks.en: Position information follows a unified rotary scheme. Reference and target image tokens share a common spatial coordinate grid and are distinguished by a temporal offset, so that spatially corresponding regions of the reference and the edited result are placed in register while remaining separable by the model. Clean reference latents and noised target latents receive distinct time conditioning, which prevents the model from confusing the fixed reference with the signal it must denoise.
blocks.zh: 位置信息遵循统一的旋转方案。 参考物和目标图像符号共享一个共同的空间坐标网格,并用时间抵消来区分,这样,参考物和编辑结果的空间对应区域就被放在注册物中,同时仍可被模型分隔. 清洁的参考潜伏物和噪声化的目标潜伏物得到不同的时间条件,从而防止模型将固定参考物与它必须暴露的信号混淆起来。

blocks.en: Because e-commerce editing frequently requires more than one reference, for example a model image together with a garment image in virtual try-on, the input stream accepts a variable number of reference images. Multiple references are encoded independently by the VAE encoder and appended to the sequence, each carrying its own positional and temporal tags. This paired multi-reference format is used consistently across training and inference so that the model learns to bind attributes from the correct source image.
blocks.zh: 由于电子商务编辑经常需要不止一个参考,例如一个模型图像与虚拟尝试中的服装图像一起,输入流接受一个可变数量的参考图像. 多个引用由VAE编码器独立编码,并附在序列上,每个编码都带有自己的位置和时间标记. 这种配对的多参考格式在整个培训和推论中一致使用,以便模型学习从正确的源图像中绑定属性.

blocks.en: 3.2 Continued Pre-Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 继续预训

blocks.en: Continued pre-training (CT) adapts the foundation model using a broad mixture of general and e-commerce editing pairs from the approximately 1.8M maintained training pairs described in section 2.7 . These data are obtained through the Data Agent described in section 2.1 . From this automatically curated pool, we retain only image pairs with resolutions above 720p for CT, adapting the model to high-resolution editing scenarios where fine-grained textures, product details, and scene structure need to remain clear and consistent. Training on this high-resolution subset combines instruction augmentation with exposure to editing operations across both domains. E-commerce data is included from the outset, allowing the model to learn from diverse e-commerce products, materials, presentation scenes, and operation types alongside general editing tasks. This stage establishes broad, high-resolution editing competence across domains, providing the foundation for the more selective SFT stage.
blocks.zh: 继续培训前(CT)调整了基础模型,使用了第2.7节所述大约1.8M型维持培训对的通用和电子商务编辑对的广泛组合。 这些数据是通过第2.1节所述数据代理获得的。 从这个自动编译的集合中,我们只保留分辨率高于720p的图像对CT,使模型适应高分辨率的编辑情景,其中精细纹理,产品细节,场景结构需要保持清晰一致. 关于这一高分辨率子集的培训将增强指令与接触两个领域的编辑操作结合起来。 电子商务数据从一开始就包含在内,使该模型能够从各种电子商务产品、材料、演示场景和操作类型以及一般编辑任务中学习。 这一阶段建立了跨领域的广泛、高分辨率编辑能力,为更具选择性的SFT阶段奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Building on the three instruction forms produced by the Caption Agent in section 2.4 , we use Qwen3-VL-32B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) to provide Chinese and English versions of each form for every source–target pair. Detailed instructions specify the editing changes and constraints, concise instructions retain the essential editing intent, and simulated-user instructions express that intent as colloquial user requests. This yields a 2 × 3 2\times 3 instruction set: two languages combined with three expression styles. All six variants preserve the same editing intent and share the same visual supervision. During training, we sample one language and one instruction form for each pair in each epoch, encouraging robustness to differences in language, specificity, and phrasing rather than dependence on a single annotation style.
blocks.zh: 根据标题代理人在第2.4节中制作的三种指导表格,我们使用Qune3-VL-32B(Bai等人,2025年),为每一种来源-目标对提供每种表格的中文和英文版本。 详细的指令规定了编辑的修改和限制,简明的指令保留了基本的编辑意图,模拟用户指令作为口语用户请求来表达这一意图. 这产生一个 2×3 2\times 3 指令集:两种语言与三种表达风格相结合. 所有六个变体都保留相同的编辑意图,并共享相同的视觉监督. 在培训期间,我们在每个时代对每对语言和教学表进行抽样,鼓励在语言、特殊性和措辞上的差异,而不是依赖单一的注释风格。

blocks.en: 3.3 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 3.3 监督罚款

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) refines the CT checkpoint on the training data curated by the Data Agent in section 2.7 . The 234.9K pairs comprise 115.0K general editing examples and 119.9K e-commerce examples, with their task distribution illustrated in Figure 5 . The general subset covers atomic and compositional editing, while the e-commerce subset includes proprietary business data collected from real merchant demands. Whereas CT emphasizes broad exposure to domains and editing operations, SFT uses this selectively curated, task-balanced corpus to improve editing precision and output quality.
blocks.zh: 监督微调(SFT)对第2.7节中由数据代理管理的培训数据改进了CT检查站. 234.9K对包括115.0K一般编辑实例和119.9K电子商务实例,其任务分布见图5。 一般子集包括原子和组成编辑,而电子商务子集包括从真实商家需求中收集的专有商业数据. 虽然CT强调广泛接触域和编辑业务,但SFT使用这种有选择地整理的、任务平衡的套件来提高编辑精度和产出质量。

blocks.en: Following the initial filtering based on Post-Filter scores, we apply an additional task-specific filter across three dimensions: instruction accuracy, content preservation, and visual quality. The screening criteria for each dimension are tailored to the editing requirements of individual subtasks, while sharing the following general principles: • Instruction accuracy. All requested modifications are completed, with no unintended changes beyond the instruction. • Content preservation. Product design, color, logos, person identity, and non-edited regions remain faithful to the reference, except where a change is explicitly requested. • Visual quality. Textures are clear, geometry is plausible, lighting and shadows are natural, and the output contains no conspicuous artifacts.
blocks.zh: 在基于Filter后分数的初始过滤后,我们额外应用了一个任务特定过滤器,覆盖三个维度:指令精度,内容保存,以及视觉质量. 每个维度的筛选标准都是根据个别子任务的编辑要求而定制的,同时分享以下一般原则: • 指令准确性. 所有要求的修改均已完成,除指令外没有意外的修改. • 内容保存。 产品设计,颜色,标志,人物身份等非编辑区域仍忠实于参考文献,但明确要求变更的除外. • 视觉质量。 纹理清晰,几何结构合理,照明和阴影是自然的,输出中没有任何明显的文物.

blocks.en: Instruction accuracy. All requested modifications are completed, with no unintended changes beyond the instruction.
blocks.zh: 指导精准. 所有要求的修改均已完成,除指令外没有意外的修改.

blocks.en: Content preservation. Product design, color, logos, person identity, and non-edited regions remain faithful to the reference, except where a change is explicitly requested.
blocks.zh: 内容保存. 产品设计,颜色,标志,人物身份等非编辑区域仍忠实于参考文献,但明确要求变更的除外.

blocks.en: Visual quality. Textures are clear, geometry is plausible, lighting and shadows are natural, and the output contains no conspicuous artifacts.
blocks.zh: 视觉品质. 纹理清晰,几何结构合理,照明和阴影是自然的,输出中没有任何明显的文物.

blocks.en: The e-commerce subset spans 11 tasks grouped into Garment & Wearable , Composition & Layout , and Text & Marketing . We maintain coverage across these tasks and the general editing categories so that high-volume tasks do not dominate the curated mixture. For tasks requiring multiple references, we retain the multi-reference input format used at inference, enabling the model to associate each reference with the appropriate subject and preserve the relevant product and identity attributes.
blocks.zh: 电子商务子集涵盖11项任务,分为服装和可穿戴、组成和布局以及文本和营销。 我们继续涵盖这些任务和一般编辑类别,以便高量任务不会主宰混合体。 对于需要多次引用的任务,我们保留推论时使用的多参考输入格式,使模型能够将每个引用与适当的主体联系起来,并保存相关的产品和身份属性.

blocks.en: 3.4 Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback
blocks.zh: 3.4 用人类反馈加强学习

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to follow editing instructions, but it optimizes a maximum-likelihood objective on curated pairs and does not directly reward the properties that determine production quality, such as instruction faithfulness, identity preservation, text legibility, and commercial appeal. We therefore add a reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) stage. Following the view that denoising can be treated as a multi-step decision process amenable to policy optimization ( Black et al., 2024 ) , we align the model against explicit reward signals rather than against a fixed reference distribution alone. Related applications of task-specific reinforcement learning span robotic control ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , multimodal reasoning and self-evolution ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Heng et al., 2026 ) , and multi-view scene editing ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 监督的微调教模型遵循编辑指令,但是它优化了对配对的最大相似性目标,并不直接奖励决定生产质量的属性,如指令的忠实性,身份保存,文本可辨读性,和商业吸引力. 因此,我们补充了从人类反馈阶段获得的强化学习。 认为可以把打假视为一个可进行政策优化的多步骤决定过程(Black等人,2024年),因此,我们将模式与明确的奖励信号而不是仅与固定的参考分布相匹配。 任务特异性强化学习的相关应用跨机器人控制(Wu等人,2025b),多式联运推理与自我演化(Jiang等人,2026;Heng等人,2026),多景场编辑(Wang等人,2026b).

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Overview of the proposed post-training framework.
blocks.zh: 图6:拟议培训后框架概览。

blocks.en: Our alignment pipeline has three parts. We first apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), combining an offline phase on curated preference pairs with an online phase that regenerates pairs from the policy, to establish a stable preference-aligned checkpoint. We then run online reinforcement learning with DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , whose reward is supplied by VLMs acting as task-conditioned judges and, for the e-commerce objectives that a general judge cannot score reliably, by three dedicated reward models targeting click-through rate, visual text rendering, and detail consistency. Because each of these objectives is optimized most effectively by its own reinforcement learning run, we finally consolidate the separately trained policies into a single model with DiffusionOPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) . The remainder of this subsection describes each component.

3.4.1 残疾人组织

blocks.en: The first alignment step is Direct Preference Optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) applied to the diffusion model ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) . We train DPO in a mixed regime that combines an offline phase on a fixed preference corpus with an online phase that draws preference pairs from the model’s own generations. The offline phase establishes a stable preference-aligned checkpoint from curated data, and the online phase keeps improving the policy against the distribution it actually produces, which mitigates the distribution shift that arises when a static offline set no longer matches the evolving model.
blocks.zh: 第一个对齐步骤是直接偏好优化(Rafailov等人,2023年)适用于扩散模型(Wallace等人,2024年). 我们训练DPO采用混合制度,将固定优惠书的离线阶段与从模式本身的几代人中汲取优惠的在线阶段结合起来。 离线阶段从整理的数据中建立一个稳定的优惠对应检查点,在线阶段不断改进政策,防止其实际产生的分配,从而缓解了静态离线设置不再符合演进模式时产生的分配转移.

blocks.en: Mixed DPO gives a stable, preference-aligned checkpoint, but it still reduces each group of candidates to a single best-versus-worst pair and supervises the model through a binary comparison, discarding both the graded magnitude of the reward and the information in the remaining candidates. We therefore hand off to online reinforcement learning with DiffusionNFT, which consumes the full graded reward over every candidate in the group and optimizes it directly on the forward diffusion process. In effect, DPO provides a robust warm start from paired preferences, and DiffusionNFT extracts a finer, continuous learning signal from the same on-policy generations once the policy is strong enough to benefit from it.
blocks.zh: 混合DPO给予稳定,偏好相配的检查点,但依然将每组候选人减少为单对最佳对最差,并通过二进制比较来监督模型,丢弃奖励的分级幅度和其余候选人的信息. 因此,我们通过“DifmusionNFT”进行在线强化学习,该学习将消耗所有评分奖励,并直接优化前期传播过程。 实际上,DPO从配对的喜好中提供了一个强劲的温暖开端,当政策足够强大,可以从中受益时,DifmusionNFT从同一个政策上世代中提取出更细腻,持续的学习信号.

blocks.en: 3.4.3 VLM as Judge
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 担任法官

blocks.en: We use Gemini 3.1 pro preview directly through its API as a fixed vision-language judge without additional fine-tuning. The judge receives the source image, any additional reference images, the editing instruction, and the generated result. A common rubric defines three integer scores from 1 to 5 for image quality, instruction alignment, and aesthetics. These dimensions assess rendering integrity, editing correctness, and visual presentation, respectively. The judge evaluates each dimension independently and provides a brief justification grounded in visible evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们直接通过它的API使用双子座3.1亲预览作为固定的视觉语言法官,而不进行额外的微调. 法官接收源图像,任何额外的参考图像,编辑指令,以及生成的结果. 一个常见的面额定义了图像质量,指令对齐,以及美学的三个整数分数从1到5. 这些维度分别对完整性、编辑正确性和视觉表现进行评估。 法官独立评估每个层面,并提供基于明显证据的简单理由。

blocks.en: Rendering fidelity is evaluated locally within the edited region and globally across the image. The assessment considers clarity and structural integrity, including geometric distortions, texture discontinuities, and inconsistencies in lighting or occlusion. Scores reflect the severity and spatial extent of these defects, with higher values indicating cleaner rendering and more coherent integration of the edit. Judgments are made within the intended visual style.
blocks.zh: 在经过编辑的区域以及整个图像的全球范围内,在当地评价忠诚度。 评估考虑了清晰度和结构完整性,包括几何扭曲、纹理不连续以及照明或闭塞方面的不一致。 分数反映了这些缺陷的严重性和空间范围,较高的数值表明是更清洁的渲染,编辑的整合更加一致. 判决是在预定的视觉风格内作出的。

blocks.en: To assess instruction alignment, the judge compares the generated result with the source and reference images under the specified editing instruction. The comparison checks the requested operations, target attributes, and spatial relations, together with the preservation of subject identity and content outside the intended edit. Preservation is judged relative to the intended transformation, allowing changes necessary to carry out the instruction. Missing requirements, incorrect targets, and unrelated alterations reduce the score, which jointly reflects editing correctness and completeness.
blocks.zh: 为了评估指令的一致,法官根据指定的编辑指令,将生成的结果与源和参考图像进行比较. 比较检查所要求的操作、目标属性和空间关系,以及在预定编辑之外保留主题身份和内容。 保护是相对于预期的转变来判断的,允许执行指令所必需的改变. 缺少要求、目标不正确和不相关的改动降低了分数,这共同反映了编辑的正确性和完整性。

blocks.en: The aesthetic assessment considers how composition, color, and tone jointly organize the visual presentation. Framing, spacing, and contrast are examined to determine whether they establish a clear focal subject and a balanced relationship with the background. In product images, this assessment places particular emphasis on product visibility and the arrangement of supporting elements. High scores require these elements to form a cohesive presentation, with harmonious color and tonal relationships, consistent styling, and minimal distraction from the intended subject.
blocks.zh: 审美评估考虑了构成,颜色,语气如何联合组织视觉呈现. 审查了结构、间隔和对比,以确定它们是否确定了一个明确的焦点主题以及与背景的平衡关系。 在产品图像中,这一评估特别强调产品的可见度和辅助要素的安排。 高分要求这些元素形成一个凝聚的呈现,具有和谐的颜色和躯干关系,始终如一的造型,最小的分散对预定对象的注意力.

blocks.en: 3.4.4 CTR Reward Model
blocks.zh: 3.4.4 化学品转移登记册 奖励模式

blocks.en: General editing quality does not capture whether a product image will attract clicks in a live storefront ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Commercial appeal is a platform-specific signal that a general vision-language judge cannot score reliably, so we train a dedicated click-through rate (CTR) reward model that predicts the relative appeal of a candidate product image.
blocks.zh: 一般编辑质量无法捕捉产品图像是否会吸引点击在直播商店前端(Wang等人,2021年;Yang等人,2024年). 商业吸引力是一个针对特定平台的信号,即一般的视觉语言法官不能可靠得分,因此我们训练一种专门的点击率(CTR)奖励模型,预测候选产品图像的相对吸引力.

blocks.en: We build the training set from platform behavior logs. For each product we gather the set of display images that have been served to users together with their logged impressions and clicks, and we form the empirical CTR of an image as its click count divided by its impression count. Two properties of raw logs make this signal noisy. An image with few impressions has a high-variance CTR estimate, and images of different products are not directly comparable because CTR is confounded by product category, price, and demand. We therefore filter the logs in two ways. First, we retain only images with more than 2,000 impressions to reduce noise in CTR estimates caused by low impression counts. Second, we build training examples only from pairs of images of the same product, which cancels product-level confounders and reduces the problem to ranking presentations of one item. We keep a pair only when its CTR ordering is consistent across all three observation windows of 7, 14, and 30 days, filtering out pairs whose ordering changes across these windows due to short-term traffic fluctuations.
blocks.zh: 我们从平台行为日志中构建培训集. 对于每个产品,我们收集已经提供给用户的一组显示图像,连同其记录的印象和点击,我们形成一个图像的经验性CTR作为它的点击数除以其印象数. 原始原木的两个特性使这个信号发出噪音. 印象很少的图像具有高变异的CTR估计,不同产品的图像无法直接比较,因为CTR被产品类别,价格,需求所混淆. 因此,我们以两种方式过滤日志。 首先,我们只保留有2000多个印象的图像,以减少低印象计数造成的CTR估计噪声. 第二,我们只从同一产品的成对图像中创建培训实例,从而取消产品层面的混淆,将问题降低到对一个项目的介绍进行排名。 我们只保留一对 当它的CTR订购一致 在所有三个观察窗口 7,14和30天, 过滤出对 其订单变化 这些窗口 由于短期流量波动。

blocks.en: The reward model encodes visual and textual product information at multiple granularities. On the visual side it encodes the full image together with a grid of local patches, which lets the model attend both to global composition and to local regions such as the product foreground and any rendered text. On the textual side it encodes the product title together with its multi-level category path. The visual and textual streams are encoded independently and fused by cross-attention, and a lightweight head maps the fused representation to a scalar score s s . Encoding the two modalities separately before fusion avoids diluting the visual signal, which we find to be the primary carrier of commercial appeal.
blocks.zh: 奖励模型在多个颗粒区编码视觉和文字产品信息. 在视觉方面,它将完整的图像与局部补丁的网格一起编码,使模型既能处理全球组成问题,也能处理产品前景和任何渲染文本等局部区域的问题。 在文字方面,它将产品标题与它的多级分类路径一起编码. 视觉和文字流是独立编码的,并且通过交叉注意来熔化,一个轻量级头部将熔化的表示图映射到一个scalar分数 s 。 在聚变前将两种方式分别编码,避免了视觉信号的稀释,我们发现视觉信号是商业吸引力的主要载体.

blocks.en: We train the reward model in two stages on the filtered same-product pairs. In the first stage we discretize observed CTR into K K buckets and train a bucket classifier with cross-entropy, which gives the encoder a coarse but stable notion of click attractiveness before it is exposed to fine-grained ranking. In the second stage we refine the model with a gap-weighted pairwise ranking loss combined with a pointwise regression term: ℒ CTR = 1 | 𝒫 | ​ ∑ ( i , j ) ∈ 𝒫 w i ​ j ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + e − ( s i − s j ) ) + λ ​ 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N ( s i − c ^ i ) 2 , w i ​ j = min ⁡ ( 1 , | c i − c j | γ ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CTR}}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{P}|}\sum_{(i,j)\in\mathcal{P}}w_{ij}\,\log\!\big(1+e^{-(s_{i}-s_{j})}\big)+\lambda\,\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\big(s_{i}-\hat{c}_{i}\big)^{2},\qquad w_{ij}=\min\!\left(1,\frac{|c_{i}-c_{j}|}{\gamma}\right), (4) where s i s_{i} is the predicted score, c i c_{i} the observed CTR, c ^ i \hat{c}_{i} the regression target, 𝒫 \mathcal{P} the set of same-product pairs with c i > c j c_{i}>c_{j} , γ \gamma a gap normalization constant, and λ \lambda the regression weight. The pairwise term follows the logistic ranking formulation of Burges et al. (2005) and teaches the model the ordering within each product, and the pointwise regression term keeps the absolute scores calibrated across products. We first compare the learned reward model against using a general-purpose vision-language model as a zero-shot CTR judge. General judges perform close to chance on pairwise CTR ranking, because commercial appeal is a platform-specific signal that is not recoverable from generic visual-text pretraining, whereas the dedicated model attains roughly 70 % 70\% pairwise ranking accuracy on our held-out pairs.

Because this benchmark provides only image input, we reduce our model to a vision-only variant. blocks.en: The model also holds a clear efficiency advantage. It scores an image with a single forward pass through a compact SigLIP2-base encoder ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) and a lightweight head, which is orders of magnitude cheaper than prompting a multi-billion-parameter vision-language judge once per candidate, and this cost difference is decisive when the model is used both as an online training reward over large candidate groups and as an offline filter across the full production catalog. Scaling the encoder further brings little benefit: replacing SigLIP2-base with SigLIP2-giant improves pairwise accuracy by only about 0.2 0.2 points, which indicates that the accuracy comes from the architecture and the training strategy rather than from encoder capacity, so a small, fast encoder is sufficient in practice. Ablations further show that the visual encoder is the primary information bottleneck, that overly fine bucket discretization introduces label noise, and that the soft gap-aware weight outperforms hard filtering of near-tie pairs. Taken together, these results justify a purpose-built, compact reward model over a prompted general judge for the commercial objective.

blocks.en: We use the CTR reward model to score and select product images. In an online A/B experiment, this selection yields an approximately 2.44 % 2.44\% relative increase in observed CTR over the control group. We evaluate how reinforcement learning with the CTR reward changes the usability of generated product images on a fixed test set. For each source image and editing instruction, the editing models before and after CTR reward optimization each produce a candidate under the same generation protocol. The original product image serves as the common control, and each model’s output is separately paired with this control. We define CTR-based usability as the fraction of evaluated pairs in which the generated image receives a strictly higher CTR than its original counterpart. Ties do not count as improvements, and both checkpoints are evaluated over the same test cases. Under this criterion, the usable proportion increases from 12.16 % 12.16\% before CTR reward optimization to 37.41 % 37.41\% afterward, an absolute gain of 25.25 25.25 percentage points. Both rates measure improvement over the original product images, rather than direct wins between the two editing models. This result shows that CTR reward optimization increases the fraction of generated candidates preferred to the original images. This is an offline measure of generated image usability. Together, the offline generation evaluation and the online selection experiment support the CTR model’s utility in guiding image generation and identifying visual assets with greater click potential.

blocks.en: Product images frequently carry dense text such as prices, promotions, and selling points, and errors in rendered text are immediately visible to shoppers ( Tuo et al., 2024 ) . String-level recognition rewards are insensitive to glyph-level defects such as missing strokes or distorted characters that harm legibility without changing the recognized string. We therefore adopt a coarse-to-fine text reward that combines a span-level term for semantic placement with a glyph-level term for structural fidelity ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .

blocks.en: 3.4.6 Fine-grained Consistency Reward Model
blocks.zh: 3.4.6 精细一致性奖励模式

blocks.en: Many e-commerce edits must preserve the identity of a product or a model across a substantial change of background, pose, or viewpoint, and pixel reconstruction losses do not capture failures such as color drift, implausible textures, or subtle identity deviation. A reward that only checks whether the overall subject looks like the same product is also insufficient, because the defects that matter commercially are often local: a mismatched cuff, a wrong button, a fabric weave that does not correspond to the source, or a detail region that is rendered plausibly but is not the part that was requested ( Li et al., 2026b ) . We therefore design a consistency reward that operates at two levels of granularity, and this multi-level formulation is a central contribution of our reward design. Concretely the reward scores a reference and a generated image along two complementary axes and combines them into a single scalar: r = α id ​ r id + α tf ​ r tf , r=\alpha_{\mathrm{id}}\,r_{\mathrm{id}}+\alpha_{\mathrm{tf}}\,r_{\mathrm{tf}}, (8) where the two axes capture, respectively: • Product identity consistency ( r id r_{\mathrm{id}} ): whether the result depicts the exact same product as the reference, verified against unique, non-generic features such as the specific fabric material, stitching and seam structure, and hardware or trims, rather than mere category or color similarity. • Target-part and detail fidelity ( r tf r_{\mathrm{tf}} ): whether the intended local part is depicted accurately and completely, with its local structure, spatial relationships, and fine process and decorative details preserved from the reference. The reward thus verifies consistency not only at the level of the overall product subject, but also at the level of the requested part and of the fine-grained details within it. This part- and detail-level supervision is what distinguishes our reward from generic identity-oriented preference models, and it directly targets the local mismatches that determine whether a commercial detail image is usable.
blocks.zh: 许多电子商务编辑必须保留产品或模型在背景、姿势或观点发生重大变化时的身份,像素重建损失不能捕捉到色彩漂移、不合理纹理或微妙身份偏差等故障。 只检查整体主体是否为同一产品的奖励也是不够的,因为商业上重要的缺陷常常是局部性的:不匹配的袖扣,错误的按钮,与源头不符的织物,或者一个细节区域被合理渲染,但不是请求的部分(Li等人,2026b). 因此,我们设计了一个一致性奖励,在两个颗粒度层次上运作,这种多层次的表述是我们奖励设计的核心贡献. 具体来说,奖励沿着两个互补轴对一个参考和生成的图像进行评分,并将其组合成一个单一的标尺:r = α id r id + α tf r tf r tf , r alpha _{\mathrm{id}}\,r_{\mathrm{id}}+\,r_{\mathrm{tf}}, (8) 两轴分别捕捉到: • 产品识别一致性(r id r_{\mathrm{id}}) : 结果是否描绘出与参考物完全相同的产品,对照特定织物材料、缝合和缝合结构、硬件或修饰等独特、非基因特征加以核实,而不是单纯的类别或颜色相似。 • 目标部分和细节忠诚(r tf r_{\mathrm{tf}}): 是否准确和完整地描绘了预期的局部部分,其局部结构,空间关系,以及精细的过程和装饰细节从参考文献中保留下来. 因此,奖励不仅在总的产品主体一级,而且在要求的部分和其中的精细细节一级都验证了一致性。 这种部分和细节层面的监督是区别我们奖励与通用的面向身份的偏好模式,直接针对决定商业细节图像是否可用的地方不匹配.

blocks.en: The reward model is a vision-language model fine-tuned to emit the two integer scores under a fixed, behavior-anchored rubric, taking the reference image, the candidate image, and the prompt as input. Each of the two axes is defined by an explicit 1-to-4 rubric with positive and negative indicators, and the rubric enforces a strict-uncertainty principle: generic similarity alone cannot earn a high score, and any uncertainty about feature matching or part accuracy must be resolved toward the lower score. This makes the learned reward conservative, which is desirable for an RL signal that would otherwise be easy to hack with superficially plausible but inconsistent edits.
blocks.zh: 奖励模型是一种视觉语言模型,经过微调,在固定的,行为焦虑的标点下释放出两个整数分数,以参考图像,候选图像,提示作为输入. 两轴的每个都由一个带有正负指标的明晰的1比4的标点来定义,标点执行一个严格的不确定性原则:光是通用相似性不能获得很高的分数,任何特性匹配或部分准确性的不确定性都必须向下分数解决. 这使得所学的奖赏保守,对于RL信号来说是可取的,否则就很容易用表面可信但不一致的编辑黑客.

blocks.en: We build the training corpus by re-annotating a large pool of reference-candidate pairs, covering both high-quality detail shots and deliberately imperfect generations, so that the model sees the full range of consistency levels rather than only near-perfect examples. A stronger vision-language model scores every pair on the two axes under the same rubric, and we retain only the integer scores as supervision. Two filtering steps keep the labels reliable: pairs on which the annotator’s rationale contradicts its score are discarded, and a held-out subset is checked so that the model separates known-consistent from known-inconsistent pairs on the identity and part-fidelity axes before it is used as a reward. We fine-tune the model for a small number of epochs on this filtered corpus.

blocks.en: 3.4.7 DiffusionOPD
blocks.zh: 3.4.7 传播OPD

blocks.en: The capability-specific objectives described above are optimized through separate reinforcement learning runs. Each objective is defined by a composite reward that combines the general-purpose VLM judge with one specialized reward model. These objectives pair the VLM judge with the corresponding specialized reward models. The VLM judge provides a shared assessment of general output quality and reduces the risk of overoptimizing exploitable patterns in any single specialized reward. Separate optimization is preferable because jointly training on heterogeneous objectives can lead to cross-task interference and imbalance in optimization difficulty. Sequentially optimizing these objectives with a single policy can instead cause catastrophic forgetting. We therefore obtain one specialized teacher for each composite task objective and consolidate the teachers into a unified model using DiffusionOPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) , an on-policy distillation method for multi-task diffusion training.
blocks.zh: 通过单独的强化学习,优化上述能力具体目标。 每个目标由一个综合奖励来界定,该奖励将通用的VLM法官与一个专门的奖励模式结合起来. 这些目标将VLM法官与相应的专业奖励模式结合起来。 志愿LM法官对一般产出质量进行共同评估,并减少在任何单一的专门奖励中过度优化可开发模式的风险。 单独优化更为可取,因为联合开展关于不同目标的培训会导致跨任务干扰和优化难度的不平衡。 以单一政策逐步优化这些目标反而会造成灾难性的遗忘。 因此,我们为每个综合任务目标获得一名专业教师,并利用传播OPD(Li等人,2026a)这一多任务传播培训的政策蒸馏方法,将教师合并为一个统一模式。

blocks.en: DiffusionOPD separates task-specific exploration from multi-task integration. In the first stage, we train task-specific teachers using DiffusionNFT. Each teacher is optimized for one composite objective and jointly considers the VLM judge and the corresponding specialized reward model. This design preserves the specialization induced by the task-specific reward while maintaining a shared notion of general output quality across all teachers. In the second stage, we distill the teachers into a single student along trajectories generated by the student itself.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 基准

blocks.en: To address the requirements of both practical business scenarios ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ; Fan et al., 2026 ) and general-purpose image editing ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025a ) , we need a reliable evaluation protocol that characterizes model behavior across domain-specific commercial applications and broad editing tasks. We therefore evaluate KwaiMind in two domains: (1) the general domain , using established image editing benchmarks that measure broad instruction-following ability, and (2) the e-commerce domain , using our 11-task Ecom-Bench with domain-tailored evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 满足两种实际业务设想的要求(Wang等人,2026a); Li等人, 2026b; Fan等人, 2026)和通用图像编辑(Wei等人, 2025年;Yu等人, 2025年; Xia等人, 2025a),我们需要一个可靠的评价协议,该协议对跨域特定商业应用和广泛编辑任务的模型行为进行定性. 因此,我们在两个领域对KwaiMind进行评价:(1) 一般域,使用既定的图像编辑基准,以衡量广泛的指导跟踪能力;(2) 电子商务域,使用我们的11个任务Ecom-Bench,并采用域名专用评价标准。

blocks.en: 4.1 General Image Editing Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.1 一般图像编辑基准

blocks.en: We assess general editing competence on three complementary public benchmarks: ImgEdit-Bench Ye et al. (2025) , which evaluates instruction following and visual quality with task-adaptive scores; GEdit-Bench Liu et al. (2025) , which combines semantic consistency and perceptual quality using VIEScore Ku et al. (2024) ; and REDEdit-Bench Team et al. (2026) , which assesses diverse editing tasks with parallel Chinese and English instructions, evaluated separately. ImgEdit averages dimension scores per sample and then across editing categories, while GEdit uses the geometric mean of semantic consistency and perceptual quality. Because the original ImgEdit and GEdit judges produced unstable scores across repeated evaluations, we use Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview for both, keeping their evaluation prompts and scoring rules unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三项补充性公共基准评估一般编辑能力: ImgEdit- Bench (英语). Ye等人(2025年),以任务调整分数评价指令后和视觉质量;Gedit-Bench Liu等人(2025年),以VIEScore Ku等人(2024年)结合语义一致性和知觉质量;ReDedit-Bench Team等人(2026年),以平行的中英文指令评价多种编辑任务,分别评价. ImgEdit平均每个样本的维度分数,然后跨编辑类别,而Gedit则使用语义一致性和知觉质量的几何平均值. 因为最初的ImgEdit和Gedit评委在反复评价中产生不稳定的分数,所以我们使用双子座3.1 Pro Preview两种评分,保持他们的评分提示和评分规则不变.

blocks.en: 4.2 Ecom-Bench: E-commerce Image Editing Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.2 电子商务 图像编辑基准

blocks.en: General-purpose editing benchmarks do not reflect the distinctive requirements of commercial image production. Tasks such as virtual try-on, selling-point poster composition, garment texture replication, and tagline removal must jointly meet requirements for product identity fidelity, typographic accuracy, and commercial visual appeal. General benchmarks neither isolate nor measure these criteria. We therefore introduce Ecom-Bench , a benchmark purpose-built for the e-commerce domain, covering 11 editing tasks under a systematic and domain-tailored evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 普通用途编辑基准并不反映商业图像制作的独特要求。 虚拟试玩,销售点海报组成,服装纹理复制,标签线清除等任务,必须共同满足产品身份诚信,印刷精度,商业视觉吸引力等要求. 一般基准既不孤立也不衡量这些标准。 因此,我们采用了Ecom-Bench,这是为电子商务领域制定的基准目的,涵盖11项根据系统化和适合域别的评价协议进行的编辑任务。

blocks.en: Each dimension is rated on a 1–5 integer scale. Every score level is specified by a concrete behavioral rubric that describes what an output at that level looks like, rather than relying on abstract adjectives such as “good” or “poor”; this behavior-anchored design reduces inter-run variance and score drift under a stochastic VLM judge. Evaluation is performed by Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, which is presented with the reference image(s), the editing instruction, and the generated output.
blocks.zh: 每个维度被评为1–5整数尺度. 每个分数级别由一个具体的行为标题来描述该级别输出的外观,而不是依赖抽象的形容词如"好"或"差";这个行为-焦虑的设计会减少运行间的差异,并在一个有弹性的VLM判断下得分漂移. 评估由双子座3.1 Pro Preview进行,它呈现的是参考图像,编辑指令,以及生成的输出.

blocks.en: The per-sample composite score is the geometric mean of the four dimension scores: S = ( d 1 ⋅ d 2 ⋅ d 3 ⋅ d 4 ) 1 / 4 , d i ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } . S=\bigl(d_{1}\cdot d_{2}\cdot d_{3}\cdot d_{4}\bigr)^{1/4},\quad d_{i}\in\{1,2,3,4,5\}. (10) We deliberately adopt the geometric mean over the arithmetic mean, as it penalizes dimension-level failures more severely. This behavior is consistent with commercial quality requirements, under which a single critical defect — garbled product text, loss of product identity, or an unnaturally fitted garment — renders an image unusable regardless of its scores on the other dimensions. Task-level scores are obtained by averaging S S over the samples of each task, and the overall Ecom-Bench score is the macro-average over the 11 tasks.

(10) 我们故意采用几何平均数,而不是算术平均数,因为它更严厉地惩罚尺寸级的失败。 这种行为符合商业质量要求,在商业质量要求下,一个单一的关键缺陷——被包装的产品文本,产品身份的丧失,或者不自然地装配的服装——使得一个图像无论在其他维度上的得分如何都无法使用. 任务级别分数通过平均SS比每个任务的样本获得,总体Ecom-Bench分数是整个11项任务的宏观平均.

blocks.en: We use the CTR reward model described in section 3.4.4 to evaluate the predicted commercial attractiveness of generated images across all 11 Ecom-Bench tasks. Trained on product impression and click logs through CTR bucket classification followed by pairwise ranking refinement, the model provides a complementary measure of learned click preferences.
blocks.zh: 我们使用第3.4.4节所述的CTR奖励模型来评价所有11个Ecom-Bench任务中生成的图像的预测商业吸引力. 该模型通过CTR桶分类进行产品印象和点击日志方面的培训,然后对双向排名进行精细化,为学习到的点击偏好提供了补充度量.

blocks.en: For comparison, we retain only test cases completed by all models included in the CTR evaluation and rank their outputs by the reward model’s scores within each case. For each model, we report the total number of appearances at ranks 1, 2, and 3, with equal weight assigned to each rank. This statistic measures how frequently a model’s output ranks among the top three under the learned CTR reward model; it does not represent measured CTR or actual click improvement.
blocks.zh: 为了比较起见,我们只保留CTR评价中包括的所有模型完成的测试案例,并按照每个案例的奖励模型的分数排列其产出。 对于每个型号,我们报告在第1,2和3级的出场总数,并给每个级别分配同等的重量. 这一统计衡量一个模型的输出在学习的CTR奖励模型中在前三名中有多频繁;它不代表测量的CTR或实际的点击改进.

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 评价议定书

blocks.en: We use Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview as the automated evaluator under a task-specific prompting protocol. For each sample, the judge is presented with the reference image(s), the editing instruction, and the generated output, and assigns scores for the four dimensions selected for that task. Virtual Try-On and Universal Wearing provide both the model and product images as references. The dimension scores are combined and aggregated as described above to obtain the per-task and overall Ecom-Bench results.
blocks.zh: 我们使用双子座3.1 Pro Preview作为任务特定提示协议下的自动评估员. 对于每个样本,法官都得到参考图像、编辑指示和生成的输出,并为该任务选定的四个维度分配分数。 Virtual Try-On和Universal Wearing同时提供模型和产品图像作为参考. 如上所述,维度分数合并,以获得Ecom-Bench的每个任务和总体结果。

blocks.en: We compare KwaiMind with six open-source image editors: Flux.2-dev Black Forest Labs (2025) , Joy-Image-Edit, Joy-Image-Edit-Plus Song et al. (2026) , LongCat Meituan LongCat Team et al. (2025) , FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0, and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 Wu et al. (2025a) , and three additional closed-source systems: Seedream5.0, NanoBanana-2, and GPT-Image-2. To make the comparison internally consistent, ImgEdit and GEdit are evaluated with the same Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview judge for every model, while REDEdit follows its original English and Chinese evaluation protocol. Ecom-Bench reports both the task-specific visual score defined in section 4.2.3 and a CTR-based comparison over the test cases completed by all models included in the CTR evaluation. For each test case, the model outputs are ranked by their predicted CTR scores; appearances at rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3 are counted, and their equal-weight sum is reported for each model. In all tables, open-source and closed-source models are separated by a horizontal rule and ranked independently: the best score within each group is bolded and the second-best is underlined.
