Team等人(2025年),FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0和Quen-Image-Edit-2511 Wu等人(2025a),以及另外三个闭源系统:Seedream5.0,NanoBanana-2和GPT-Image-2. 为了使内部的比较一致,ImgEdit和Gedit被评价为每个模型的同一双子座3.1 Pro预览裁判,而ReDedit遵循其英文和中文的原评价协议. Ecom-Bench既报告第4.2.3节定义的任务特定视觉分数,也报告基于CTR的比对CTR评价包含的所有模型完成的测试案例. 对于每个测试案例,模型输出按其预测的CTR分数排序;在1级,2级和3级的外观被计算,并且报告每个模型的等重总和. 在所有表格中,开源模型和闭源模型通过横向规则分离,并独立排序:每个组内的最佳分数为粗体,下划线为第二.

blocks.en: 5.1 General Image Editing Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 一般图像编辑结果

blocks.en: Figure 3 gives an overview of the aggregate results, while Tables 6 and 7 provide the complete task-level breakdown. KwaiMind achieves the best overall result among open-source models on all four general benchmarks: 4.15 on ImgEdit, 6.29 on GEdit, 3.75 on REDEdit English, and 3.73 on REDEdit Chinese. The improvements are not confined to a single edit family. On ImgEdit, KwaiMind leads the open-source group on background and compositional editing and ranks second on replacement and extraction. On GEdit, it obtains the strongest open-source result on material alteration, motion change, human editing, style change, subject removal, and subject replacement. This breadth indicates that continued pre-training preserves general editing competence despite the subsequent specialization toward e-commerce data.
blocks.zh: 图3概述了总体结果,表6和表7提供了全部任务层次的细目。 KwaiMind在所有四个一般基准的开源模型中取得了最佳的总体结果:ImgEdit4.15、Gedit6.29、ReDedit英文3.75和ReDedit中文3.73。 这些改进并不局限于一个单一的编辑家庭。 在ImgEdit上,KwaiMind在背景和组成编辑上领导开源组,在替换和提取上排名第二. 在Gedit上,它在物质改变,运动改变,人类编辑,风格改变,主题删除,以及主题替换上获得了最强的开源结果. 这一广度表明,尽管随后专门处理电子商务数据,但持续的培训前工作保留了一般编辑能力。

blocks.en: The bilingual REDEdit results further show that the gain transfers across languages. KwaiMind ranks first among open-source systems on both English and Chinese overall scores, with particularly strong results for composition, extraction, portrait editing, motion, and removal. The English and Chinese scores are also close, suggesting that the bilingual instruction augmentation used during CT does not favor one language at the expense of the other. Closed-source systems remain stronger overall: GPT-Image-2 reaches 7.10 on GEdit and 4.17/4.22 on REDEdit EN/CN, while Seedream obtains the highest ImgEdit score of 4.27. The remaining gap is concentrated in several difficult categories, including viewpoint changes and some fine-grained appearance edits.
blocks.zh: 双语REDDD结果进一步表明,各种语言之间的收益转移。 KwaiMind在英语和中文总体分数上在开源系统中名列第一,在组成、提取、肖像编辑、动作和删除方面成绩尤其显著。 英语和汉语的分数也比较接近,说明CT期间使用的双语教学增强法并不偏好一种语言而牺牲另一种语言. 封闭源代码系统整体上依然较强:GPT-Image-2在Gedit上达到7.10,在ReDedit EN/CN上达到4.17/4.22,而Seedream则获得最高的ImgEdit得分4.27. 剩下的差距集中在几个困难的类别,包括观点变化和一些精细的外观编辑.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ecom-Bench Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 Ecom-Bench 结果

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the Ecom-Bench visual and CTR ranking results, while Table 8 reports the per-task visual scores and the aggregate CTR ranking score. KwaiMind achieves an overall visual score of 3.67, outperforming every open-source baseline. KwaiMind leads the open-source group on Clothing Display, Universal Wearing, Clothing Detail, Pose Change, Background Replace, Tagline Removal, and the overall score. The largest margins occur on Clothing Detail and Clothing Display, where the model must preserve local appearance or transfer garments while maintaining identity and structure. These results align with the emphasis of the SFT data mixture and the fine-grained consistency reward.
blocks.zh: 图1总结了Ecom-Bench视觉和CTR排名结果,而表8则报告每个任务视觉分数和总的CTR排名分数. 桂明德实现总视差3.67分,优于每个开源基线. KwaiMind 领导关于服装显示,通用服装穿戴,服装细节,Pose 更改,背景替换,标签删除的开源组,以及总体分数. 最大的边幅出现在服装细节和服装显示器上,模型必须保留当地外观或转让服装,同时保持身份和结构。 这些结果与SFT数据混合物的强调和精细的连贯性奖励一致.

blocks.en: Performance is less uniform on Outpaint and Product Extract. Flux.2-dev obtains the strongest open-source Outpaint score, while Joy-Image-Edit leads Product Extract. These categories indicate that specialization does not uniformly dominate strong task-specific priors and remain important directions for further improvement. Joy-Image-Edit and LongCat do not support the multi-image inputs required by Virtual Try-On and Universal Wearing and therefore lack results for those tasks; their reported overall values are macro-averages over nine available tasks rather than all eleven and should be interpreted with this limitation.
blocks.zh: 在Outpaint和产品提取上性能不太统一. Flux2-dev获得最强的开源Outpaint分数,而Joy-Image-Edit则领先产品提取. 这些类别表明,专业化并不统一地支配着针对具体任务的有力前科,仍然是进一步改进的重要方向。 Joy-Image-Edit和LongCat不支持Virtual Try-On和Universal Wearing要求的多图像输入,因此在这些任务方面缺乏成果;它们所报告的总体值是9项现有任务的宏观平均数,而不是全部11项,因此应该以这一局限性来解释。

blocks.en: The closed-source systems retain a clear advantage in the visual evaluation. GPT-Image-2 achieves the strongest closed-source score on ten of the eleven tasks and an overall score of 4.20, followed by NanoBanana-2 at 4.01. KwaiMind nevertheless narrows the gap on several specialized tasks: its scores on Clothing Detail, Pose Change, and Clothing Display are close to the strongest proprietary results, demonstrating that targeted data and reward design can substantially improve production-oriented capabilities without relying on a closed model.
blocks.zh: 闭源系统在视觉评价中保留了明显的优势. GPT-Image-2在11项任务中的10项中实现了最强的闭源得分,总得分4.20分,其次是纳诺巴纳纳-2以4.01分. 尽管如此,KwaiMind还是缩小了在若干专门任务上的差距:它在服装细节、Pose Change和服装显示方面的得分接近最强的专有成果,表明有针对性的数据和奖励设计可以在不依赖封闭模型的情况下大幅度提高面向生产的能力。

blocks.en: Joy-Image-Edit and LongCat support only single-image inputs, so we exclude them from the CTR comparison. We evaluate the remaining eight models on all 1,100 test cases. For each case, the model outputs are sorted by their predicted CTR scores, and appearances at rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3 are counted separately. The three counts are equally weighted and summed to form the reported CTR ranking score. As shown in Figure 1 , KwaiMind records 215, 164, and 165 appearances at the three ranks, respectively, yielding the highest aggregate score of 544. This result complements the VLM-based visual score by measuring how consistently a model places among the most commercially attractive candidates under the learned preference model. Such a signal is valuable because a visually faithful edit is not necessarily an effective retail creative. Prior work on CTR-aware creative generation and product-poster optimization similarly uses behavioral feedback to guide generation beyond aesthetics alone ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) ; thus, KwaiMind’s gain indicates stronger practical potential for producing deployable commercial imagery, rather than only higher judge-based visual quality.
blocks.zh: Joy-Image-Edit和LongCat只支持单图像输入,所以我们把它们排除在CTR比较之外. 我们对所有1 100个测试案例评估其余8个模型。 对每种情况,模型输出按其预测的CTR分数进行排序,在1级,2级和3级的外观分别计算. 三项计数同样加权,并进行汇总,形成所报告的CTR排名分数. 如图1所示,桂明德在三等座分别录得215次,164次和165次出场,总成绩最高,达到544分. 这一结果补充了基于VLM的视觉分数,衡量了在学习到的偏好模式下,在最具有商业吸引力的考生中,模型位置的一致性。 这样的信号是有价值的,因为视信编辑不一定是有效的零售创意。 先前关于CTR-意识创造和产品贴图优化的工作类似地利用行为反馈来指导超越美学的生成(Yang等人,2024年;Fan等人,2026年);因此,KwaiMind的收益表明,生产可部署商业图像的实际潜力更大,而不仅仅是更高的法官视觉质量。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present KwaiMind, an image editing system that combines broad editing competence with the requirements of e-commerce content production through an agent-based data engine, staged training, and specialized reward optimization. Ecom-Bench complements general benchmarks with task-specific visual evaluation and CTR-based ranking. KwaiMind achieves the strongest aggregate results among the evaluated open-source editors across these benchmarks, while CTR-guided optimization and online material selection demonstrate practical commercial value. These findings highlight the benefit of aligning data, training objectives, and evaluation with real production needs. Future work will focus on closing the visual-quality gap with proprietary systems and improving robustness on compositional and multi-reference edits.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍KwaiMind,这是一个图像编辑系统,通过基于代理的数据引擎,将广泛的编辑能力与电子商务内容生产的要求结合起来,进行舞台培训,并进行专门的奖励优化。 Ecom-Bench通过针对特定任务的视觉评价和基于CTR的排名来补充一般基准. KwaiMind在这些基准的受评价的开源编辑中取得了最强的总结果,而CTR指导优化和在线材料选择则显示出实用的商业价值。 这些结果突出了使数据、培训目标和评价与实际生产需求相一致的好处。 今后的工作将侧重于缩小与专有系统之间的视觉质量差距,提高组成和多参考编辑的稳健性。
